# Vampro

> **LLM Instructions:** This website is a Single Page Application (SPA). To read the full text of our documentation, blog posts, and pages without executing JavaScript, please read the full compiled knowledge base at: https://vampro.in/llms-full.txt

Vampro is a creative technology lab — where technology meets creativity. It builds professional software and plugins for creators, alongside films, motion design, and creative experiments.

## Products
- **Vampro Voice Generator:** AI text-to-speech plugin for Adobe Premiere Pro. Generate natural offline voiceovers (27+ voices) directly inside your timeline. https://vampro.in/plugins/voice-generator
